attractive:
a. 吸引人的, 有魅力的
[法] 有吸引力的, 有迷惑力的

a. pleasing to the eye or mind especially through beauty or charm
s. having power to arouse interest

語感
中性，描述人或物都可用
詞根詞綴
拉丁 attractivus；attract ＋ -ive
字族
unattractive (形容詞)、attractively (副詞)
常見搭配
an attractive young woman；an attractive salary；an attractive location；find him attractive
近義詞
good-looking：多指人，口語常用
pretty：多指女孩或女性
handsome：多指男性
注意事項
attractive 也可指職位、價格等「有吸引力」；形容人時語氣比 beautiful 淡
attractively: adv. 動人地, 迷人地
attractiveness: [經] 吸引性, 有利可圖
attractor:
n. 引人注意的人
[化] 吸引子
n. (physics) a point in the ideal multidimensional phase space that is used to describe a system toward which the system tends to evolve regardless of the starting conditions of the system
attributable: <dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>偏正式，常見於新聞、報告與學術寫作</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>attributable to；be attributable to a poor diet；be attributable to a rise in the cost of paper</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">固定與 to 連用：A is attributable to B，表示 A 的原因是 B</dd></dl>
attribute:
n. 屬性, 標誌, 定語
vt. 把...歸於, 認為...屬於
[計] 屬性
n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of an entity

語感
中性；動詞用法在學術與正式寫作中常見
詞根詞綴
拉丁 attribuere，由 ad-「向」＋ tribuere「分配、給予」組成，原意「分給、歸給」
字族
attributable (形容詞)、attributive (形容詞)
常見搭配
attribute something to somebody/something；attribute blame；best attribute；possess the attributes
近義詞
characteristic：使人事物與眾不同的特徵
quality：多指人身上（尤其是好的）特質
trait：專指人的性格特質
注意事項
名詞與動詞的重音不同：名詞 ATtribute，動詞 atTRIBute；動詞常用 attribute A to B「把 A 歸因於 B」
attribution:
n. 歸因
[法] 歸因, 歸屬, 屬性

n. assigning some quality or character to a person or thing
n. assigning to a cause or source
attributive:
a. 歸屬的, 屬性的, 定語的
n. 定語
a. of adjectives; placed before the nouns they modify
attrition:
n. 摩擦, 磨損
[醫] 擦除術; 磨耗

n. sorrow for sin arising from fear of damnation
n. a wearing down to weaken or destroy

attune: vt. 為樂器調音, 使協調, 使合拍
v. adjust or accustom to; bring into harmony with
attuned: v. 使協調( attune的過去式和過去分詞 ); <音>調音
v adjust or accustom to; bring into harmony with
atypical:
a. 非典型的
[醫] 非典型的, 不標準的

a. not representative of a group, class, or type
s. deviating from normal expectations; somewhat odd, strange, or abnormal

語感
中性，偏書面
詞根詞綴
a-「非」＋ typical「典型的」；typical 源自希臘 typikos
常見搭配
an atypical case；atypical of her previous work；atypical behaviour
注意事項
說『不像某人或某作品』時接 of，如 atypical of her previous work
字族
atypically (adverb)
atypically: r. in a manner that is not typical
